title: Chicken and Flat Dumplings in Parsley Gravy
description: Thin, hand-cut dumplings simmer in the chicken cooking broth, which becomes a parsley gravy around the tender thigh pieces.
equipment: Heatproof measuring jug and slotted spoon

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken thighs
ingredients.note: Use plain, unenhanced poultry. Remove visible fat before weighing.

ingredients.name: low-sodium chicken broth
ingredients.note: Use plain chicken-and-water broth without a vegetable blend or added seasoning.

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.note: Spoon into the measure and level.

ingredients.name: skim milk
ingredients.note: Add gradually to make a supple dough.

ingredients.name: fresh flat-leaf parsley leaves
ingredients.note: Remove coarse stems and mince the leaves finely.

steps.title: Make the dumpling dough
steps.text: Mix {flour} with {butter}. Work in {milk} gradually until the dough holds together. Rest covered for 8 minutes.

steps.title: Heat the broth
steps.text: Meanwhile put {broth} and {bay} into the PossibleCooker. Use Sear/Sauté HIGH with the lid off until the broth simmers, about 5–8 minutes.

steps.title: Poach the chicken
steps.text: Cut {chicken} across the grain into 1-inch pieces and lower into the broth. Return to a simmer and switch to Sear/Sauté LOW, lid off. Cook gently for 10–17 minutes. Pull the pieces at 175°F and cover in a bowl with some of the broth.

steps.title: Cut the dumplings
steps.text: Roll the rested dough between parchment sheets to about 1/8 inch thick. Cut short ribbons about 1/2 inch wide and 1 inch long.

steps.title: Simmer the ribbons
steps.text: Remove the bay leaf. Bring the broth back to a steady simmer and slip in the ribbons a few at a time. Cook uncovered for 8–12 minutes, stirring gently, until a split dumpling has no floury core.

steps.title: Measure the gravy base
steps.text: Lift the cooked dumplings into the bowl with the chicken. Reserve 1/2 cup of the remaining hot broth per serving in the cooker; set aside any surplus to loosen the finished dish.

steps.title: Thicken the parsley gravy
steps.text: Add {parsley} to the simmering broth. Stir in the slurry and maintain a gentle bubble for 1 minute, until the gravy coats the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Bring the dish together
steps.text: Turn the cooker off. Fold the chicken, its juices and the dumplings into the gravy. Add reserved broth a spoonful at a time if the dumplings tighten the sauce and ladle into four bowls.

notes: Sauce yield: About 2 cups for four, or 1/2 cup per bowl. Make ahead: Roll and cut the dumplings up to a day ahead and refrigerate them between sheets of parchment. Cook them directly in the chicken broth. For dairy-free dumplings, use unsweetened oat milk and avocado oil in place of skim milk and butter. Chill leftovers promptly in shallow portions and refrigerate for up to 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. The soft flat dumplings freeze well enough for a spoonable meal for up to 6 weeks. Add a splash of broth on reheating as they absorb gravy. Fridge reheat: Warm one portion covered in its sauce in a HexClad skillet over medium-low, loosening with a splash of water if needed. Stir or turn the chicken gently, checking from 6 minutes, until it reaches 165°F throughout. Freezer reheat: Thaw overnight in the refrigerator, then follow the fridge reheating directions and stir the sauce smooth. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/4 of recipe): 325 kcal, 34.0 g protein, 28.6 g total carbohydrate, 7.1 g fat, 0.9 g fiber, 181 mg sodium. Includes the measured broth and sauce. Sodium varies with your broth.
